app.title: LinkWatch
app.footer: LinkWatch · Dead link and outage monitoring · watch.hueai.net

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use the email and password of your LinkWatch account.

newPassword.title: Set a new password
newPassword.description: This is your first sign-in. Choose a password to replace the temporary one from the invitation email.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a verification code.
forgot.confirmDescription: If an account exists for {{email}}, a verification code is on its way. It may take a minute to arrive.

notice.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
notice.codeSent: Code sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

fieldErrors.codeRequired: Enter the code from the email

errors.user_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.invalid_password: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.code_mismatch: The code is incorrect. Check the email and try again.
errors.code_expired: The code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.unconfigured: Sign-in is not configured for this site. Contact your administrator.

home.intro: Add links to monitor and see their latest check status.

links.title: Links
links.empty: No links yet. Add your first link above.

refresh.fast: Refreshing every 30 seconds while links wait for a check result.
refresh.slow: Refreshes every 5 minutes. New links are checked within 5 minutes.

errors.dateRange: Must be on or after the start date

links.subtitle: Add links to monitor and see their latest check results.

bulk.label: Actions on selected links
bulk.selectPage: Select all links on this page

errors.unsupported_scheme: Only http:// and https:// are supported
errors.duplicate: This link is already in the list
errors.unknown: Could not add the link. Please try again.

settingsEmail.subtitle: Who sends LinkWatch alerts, who receives them by default, and how often reminders go out.
settingsEmail.loadError: Could not load the email settings.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Alerts are sent through Amazon SES. The address must belong to the verified domain {{identity}}.
sender.name: Sender name

admin.title: Default admin email
admin.description: Receives alerts for links and domains that have no recipients of their own, and the network-problem notice.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Remind recipients while an incident stays open and nobody has acknowledged it.

test.title: Send a test email
test.description: Checks that {{sender}} can deliver to an address. Leave the field empty to send it to yourself.
test.failed: The test email could not be sent.
test.sandboxHint: While the SES account is in the sandbox, only verified addresses can receive email (see the runbook).

errors.senderName: Enter a sender name (up to 64 characters)
errors.interval: Enter a whole number of hours between 1 and 720
errors.validation: Some values were rejected. Check the fields and try again.

settingsEmail.readOnly: Only admins can change email settings and send a test email.

incidents.subtitle: Open and closed incidents: how long a link was down, who was emailed, and notes.

empty.active: No open incidents. Every link is working.

incidents.notFound: This incident does not exist (the link may be wrong).

ack.title: Acknowledge
ack.hint: Acknowledge to tell the team you are on it. Reminders stop once acknowledged.
ack.notePlaceholder: What is being done, e.g. "Deploying a fix"
ack.closed: This incident was closed in the meantime.

emails.title: Emails sent
emails.none: No email has been sent about this incident yet (emails go out about 5 minutes after it opens).

linkDetail.title: Link details
linkDetail.notFound: This link does not exist or was deleted.

checkNow.slow: No result after 60 seconds yet. The check is still queued; refresh in a moment.
checkNow.paused: This link is paused, so it is not checked.
checkNow.notQueued: The link could not be queued for a check.
checkNow.failed: Could not start the check. Try again.

checks.title: Last {{count}} checks
checks.none: This link has not been checked yet.

editLink.title: Edit link
editLink.urlChangeHint: A new URL starts again as Pending and is checked within 5 minutes.
editLink.keywordHint: The page must contain this text (not case-sensitive).

errors.codes: Enter codes or ranges between 100 and 599, e.g. 200-399, 404
errors.timeoutS: Enter a whole number of seconds between 1 and 60
errors.name: Up to 200 characters

editLink.scheduleHint: Own schedule of this link; otherwise the domain schedule or the default one applies.

importLinks.title: Import links
importLinks.help: Paste one URL per line, or a CSV with a header row: url (required), name, tags (separated by ;), method, expected_codes (e.g. 200-399;404), timeout_s, keyword. Up to {{max}} rows.
importLinks.moreRows: … and {{count}} more rows (counted in the summary).

errors.tooLarge: Too many rows: at most {{max}} per import.
errors.failed: Could not read the import. Try again.
errors.partial: The import stopped after {{count}} links. Preview again to import the rest.

schedules.subtitle: Reusable check schedules. A link uses its own schedule, else its domain's, else the default one.
schedules.defaultHint: Used by every link and domain without a schedule of its own.
schedules.inUse: This schedule is used by {{domains}} domains and {{links}} links. Assign them another schedule first.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.monthDaysHint: Days 29–31 run on the last day of shorter months.

domains.subtitle: Links grouped by root domain: status, uptime and settings of each domain.
domains.empty: No domain yet. Domains are created when you add links.

fields.scheduleHint: Links without their own schedule follow this one.
fields.enabledHint: Off: the links of this domain are not checked.
fields.slowAlert: Email when a link is slow
fields.slowAlertHint: Slow links only show in yellow unless this is on.
fields.ignoreWaf403Hint: Some sites block AWS addresses with 403; count it as reachable instead of a dead link.

errors.invalid: Some values were rejected (check the owner email).

recipients.title: Alert recipients
recipients.hint: They get incident, recovery and reminder emails for every link of this domain.
recipients.none: No recipient: alerts go to the default admin email.
recipients.name: Name (optional)

confirm.title: Fixed — check again
confirm.intro: Did you fix it? Confirm and LinkWatch checks the link right away, then again after 2 and 5 minutes if needed.
confirm.again: The last check did not succeed. You can report it fixed again.
confirm.hint: Only a real check can close the incident, so confirming by mistake changes nothing.

outcome.fixed: Fixed — the link works again. Everyone was emailed.
outcome.still_failing: Still failing after 3 checks. Only you were told; the incident stays open.

confirm.recovered: The link recovered before anyone reported it fixed. Nothing to do.
confirm.expired: The link is older than 7 days or no longer valid. Open LinkWatch to see the current state.
confirm.loadError: Could not load this page. Try again in a moment.
confirm.submitError: Could not start the check. Try again.

claims.title: Reported fixed
claims.hint: Fixed it? LinkWatch checks the link now, after 2 and after 5 minutes; the first success closes the incident.
claims.none: Nobody has reported this incident as fixed yet.
claims.started_one: Checking the incident now, then after 2 and 5 minutes.
claims.started_other: Checking {{count}} incidents now, then after 2 and 5 minutes.
claims.failed: Could not start the checks. Try again.

overview.subtitle: Health of every domain at a glance.
overview.empty: No links yet. Add links to start monitoring.
overview.noneResolved: No incidents resolved in the last 24 hours.

account.subtitle: Your sign-in account.
account.password: To change your password, sign out and use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
account.users: Admins invite users and change their roles under Settings → Users.

roles.admin: Admin — full access: users, email settings, the default schedule, every domain and link.
roles.editor: Editor — adds and edits links, domains, schedules and recipients; acknowledges and fixes incidents.
roles.viewer: Viewer — read only: dashboard, links, history and incidents.

users.subtitle: Who can sign in to LinkWatch and what they can do.
users.inviteHint: Amazon Cognito emails a temporary password. It is valid for 7 days; on the first sign-in the user chooses their own password.

roleHint.admin: Full access, including users and email settings.
roleHint.editor: Edits links, domains, schedules and recipients; handles incidents.

users.signOutNote: A new role or a disabled account takes effect at the user's next sign-in, at the latest within one hour.
users.loadError: Could not load users. Try again.

errors.duplicate: This email already has an account.
errors.self_change: You cannot change your own role, disable or delete yourself.
errors.last_admin: At least one enabled admin must remain.
errors.not_invited: This user has already set a password; there is no invite to resend.
